About.title: About Our School
About.missionP1: The Polish Supplementary School named after Julian Ursyn Niemcewicz in Plainfield, New Jersey is a community school dedicated to teaching the Polish language, literature, history and culture to children growing up outside Poland.
About.missionP2: We believe that language is the foundation of identity. Our teachers passionately share knowledge of Polish heritage in every lesson.
About.val1Desc: Rigorous and engaging Polish language instruction at all levels.
About.val2Desc: Celebrating Polish traditions, holidays, history and arts.
About.val3Desc: Building bonds between Polish families in our area.
About.c1desc: Introduction to the alphabet, basic vocabulary and songs.
About.c4desc: Advanced grammar, reading and exam preparation.
